fields.name: KeyBindingsRefreshed
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x12B5A30 (gui::input::TrackingSystem update) drains its message queue (system+0x80): message variant index 0 inserts the 2-byte payload with bg3.exe+0x796C40 (hash of a short, keys compared as short at Keys + i*2) into component+0; the set is cleared each update (bg3.exe+0x5C4330) when its key count +0x2C is non-zero. macOS gui::input::TrackingSystem::OnKeyBindingsRefresh(short const&) is the handler taking a short. Creator bg3.exe+0x12B5EB0 zeroes +0..+0x30.

fields.name: InputDevice
fields.evidence: Message variant index 1 stores its 2-byte payload at +0x30 (*(undefined2*)(comp+0x30)); macOS TrackingSystem::OnUIInputDeviceChanged(ls::EInputDeviceID) - enum ls::EInputDeviceID written as its 2-byte integer.

fields.name: InputDeviceChanged
fields.evidence: Message 1 sets the byte at +0x32 to 1 together with InputDevice; the update resets it to 0 the next frame; creator zeroes it.

open_questions: What the int16 keys are (player ids whose key bindings were refreshed, by the macOS handler name); names are inferred from the macOS signal handlers.
